mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_stat (user_id, ) VALUES (#{userId}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE = GREATEST( + #{delta}, 0)

INSERT INTO user_stat (user_id, like_received, read_received) SELECT #{userId}, COALESCE(SUM(s.like_count), 0), COALESCE(SUM(s.read_count), 0) FROM article a JOIN article_stat s ON s.article_id = a.id WHERE a.author_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_received = VALUES(like_received), read_received = VALUES(read_received)
